card.name: Cortisol-lowering drug labels: small linking words
card.fires_on: Small linking or punctuation tokens and section-number digits in labels for cortisol-lowering drugs (LYSODREN/mitotane, RECORLEV). Often just before a number, a drug name or a cortisol term.

modes.label: Section reference numbers
modes.description: The first digit or space inside a bracketed section cross-reference such as (5.3) or (2.4).

modes.label: Linking words before drug or lab terms
modes.description: Words like of, with, or a comma or space just before a drug name or cortisol measure.
